injury.comment: Doncic (back) is out for Wednesday's game against the Clippers.
Sengun (back) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Bucks.
Edwards will undergo arthroscopic right knee surgery and is expected to miss up to two months, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Leonard (knee) is expected to miss multiple weeks due to swelling in his left knee, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Duren will be re-evaluated in two weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.
Ingram (Achilles) is making progress but is set to miss at least one more week, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.
Haliburton (hamstring) will miss at least the next two weeks of action, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Holmgren (knee) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Mavericks.
Knueppel (hamstring) is without a timetable for a return, Rod Boone of The Charlotte Observer reports.

note: Projections, not prices: no sportsbook lines are used. Built from L5/L10/L15/L20 averages, opponent defense by position, head to head, rest and injuries. Early in the season the windows reach back into last year's games.

backtest.basis: 99 players, 2025-26 games after each player's 8th, one game ahead, no lines
backtest.read: The half and half blend is a hair better than the season average and better than the windows alone. Opponent defense and home/away added nothing measurable, so defense is applied at a small weight and the home/away split is shown but not applied. A typical miss on points is about 6, so treat every number as a range, not a pick.
